threads.title: The King resurrected and ascended sending out the Twelve — Ascension of Isaiah 11's external-witness to the Matt 28 resurrection-and-Great-Commission architecture (FRAMEWORK-MAJOR)
threads.summary_md: Matt 28's three movements — the substantial-Resurrection at vv.1-10 + the substantial-chief-priests' counter-narrative at vv.11-15 + the substantial-Great-Commission at vv.16-20 — read against the deepest external-witness articulation of the same architecture in the entire restored library: Ascension of Isaiah 11. Four moves: AI 11:19 names the adversary-roused-the-children-of-Yashar'el (Israel)-against-Him-not-knowing-who-He-was substance — the system-not-people architecture per Red Line #9 named explicitly at the wisdom-stream-vision-register (the system is the leadership-substance walked-substantively-into-the-bribery-cover-up at Matt 28:11-15; the people are the victims-of-the-substantial-deception-the-leadership-handed-them-in-good-faith; the *commonly reported among the Yahudim (Jews) until this day* substance is NOT categorical-anti-Yahudi (Jewish) substance per the framework's rejection-of-the-inherited-Christian-collapse); AI 11:21 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the substantial-third-day-rise-again substance (*And likewise after the third day rise again and remain days*) — the substantial-Resurrection-substance the heavenly-messenger announces at the empty-tomb at v.6; AI 11:22 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the substantial-Great-Commission + Ascension substance (*And I saw when He sent out the Twelve Apostles and ascended*) — the substantial-sending-out-of-the-Twelve at v.19 + the implicit-Ascension named-explicitly at Acts 1:9-11; AI 11:32 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the substantial-Ascension-to-the-right-hand-of-the-Great-Glory substance (*And then I saw Him sit down on the right hand of that Great Glory*) — the operative-substance of Psalm 110:1 + Daniel 7:13-14 + the substantial *all power is given unto me in heaven and in earth* substance at v.18. Per Yoshi's S32 sourcing-decision (api/seed.py:EDITION_PROFILES["ascension-isaiah"]), Ascension of Isaiah is the *first witness* aligning with the framework's Formless-Father / Formed-of-the-Formless nature-of-God teaching at the deepest external-witness level — pre-Nicene, late-1st / early-2nd CE, before the Constantine-era doctrinal-construct hardened. The wisdom-stream-prophetic-substance the prophet-Yeshayahu (Isaiah) walks at the heavenly-vision-register and the gospel-substance the apostle-Mattithyahu (Matthew) walks at the historical-pivot cohere comprehensively at the Matt 28 architecture. FRAMEWORK-MAJOR.

members_in_this_chapter.member_note: Ascension of Isaiah 11:21 — *after the third day rise again and remain days.* Isaiah is shown the rising after the third day and the days He remained, which the angel at the tomb announces as fulfilled.

Ascension of Isaiah 11:19 — *the adversary envied Him and roused the children of Yashar'el (Israel) against Him, not knowing who He was.* The adversary roused the people not knowing who He was, and Matthew shows the leadership answering the truth with a cover story.
Ascension of Isaiah 11:22 — *I saw when He sent out the Twelve Apostles and ascended.* The sending of the Twelve and the ascension are seen together, as Matthew's last words to the Twelve are spoken.

Ascension of Isaiah 11:32 — *I saw Him sit down on the right hand of that Great Glory.* The Son sits at the right hand of the Great Glory, the Father, and Matthew has him say that all power is given unto him.

threads.title: All power given — the Son of Adam seated on the throne of glory in 1 Enoch's Parables
threads.summary_md: When the risen King says *And Yahusha (Jesus) came and spake unto them, saying, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.* (Matthew 28:18), he is not announcing something new. He is stepping into a seat the prophets had already described. Daniel saw it given: *And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all people, nations, and languages, should serve him: his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed.* (Daniel 7:14), and David heard the Father speak it: *Yahuah (LORD) said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.* (Psalms 110:1). The Parables of Enoch had set the same figure on the same throne long before: *And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits placed the Elect One on the throne of glory. And he shall judge all the works of the holy above in the heaven, And in the balance shall their deeds be weighed.* (1 Enoch 61:8), and again, *And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits seated him on the throne of His glory, And the spirit of righteousness was poured out upon him, And the word of his mouth slays all the sinners, And all the unrighteous are destroyed from before his face.* (1 Enoch 62:2). The power is over earth as much as heaven, because the kings of the earth answer to it: *And all the kings and the mighty and the exalted and those who rule the earth Shall fall down before him on their faces, And worship and set their hope upon that Son of Adam, And petition him and supplicate for mercy at his hands.* (1 Enoch 62:9). And the first thing that authority does is open the graves and sort who comes out of them: *And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, And Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, And hell shall give back that which it owes. And he shall choose the righteous and holy from among them: For the day has drawn nigh that they should be saved.* (1 Enoch 51:1-2). The empty tomb at the start of Matthew 28 and the *all power* at the end of it belong to the same morning. The Son of Adam who came out of the grave is the one who will call the rest of the seed out of theirs.

members_in_this_chapter.member_note: 1 Enoch 51:1 — *the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it.* The firstfruits walked out (Matthew 28:6); all power follows (Matthew 28:18).

1 Enoch 51:2 — *he shall choose the righteous and holy from among them.* The sifting after the gathering, done by the one given all power (Matthew 28:18). The tares were never wheat; the wheat is sifted.

*And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits placed the Elect One on the throne of glory. And he shall judge all the works of the holy above in the heaven, And in the balance shall their deeds be weighed.* (1 Enoch 61:8). *All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth* (Matthew 28:18). Enoch saw the placing — Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits setting the Elect One on the throne of glory to judge and to weigh deeds in the balance. The Father is the giver; the Son is seated; the power is the power to judge.

*And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits seated him on the throne of His glory, And the spirit of righteousness was poured out upon him, And the word of his mouth slays all the sinners, And all the unrighteous are destroyed from before his face.* (1 Enoch 62:2). *All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth* (Matthew 28:18). Enoch saw the giving: the Elect One seated on the throne of glory, the spirit of righteousness poured out on him, the word of his mouth slaying the sinners. The power was given by the Father; the Son wields it.

*And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, [And the strong from their thrones] And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners.* (1 Enoch 46:4). *All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth* (Matthew 28:18). Enoch's Son of Adam raises the kings and the mighty from their seats and breaks the teeth of the sinners. That is what all power looks like when it is used.

threads.title: Panta ta ethnē as the SCOPE-of-proclamation because the sheep are scattered through every nation — Jubilees 1's gathering-from-the-nations + 2 Esdras 13's ten-tribes-in-a-far-country (FRAMEWORK-MAJOR — the signature framework-load for Matt 28)
threads.summary_md: Matt 28:19-20's *Go ye therefore, and teach all nations* (Greek *poreuthentes oun mathēteusate panta ta ethnē*) + *teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you* — the SIGNATURE FRAMEWORK-LOAD of Matt 28 — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the substantial-scope-of-the-proclamation-because-the-sheep-are-scattered architecture per Red Line #11. The audience is the citizens-of-the-kingdom-scattered-among-the-territories-of-the-nations whom we do-not-know-by-sight; the proclamation goes broadly; those-who-hear-are-revealed-to-be-sheep-because-they-were-sheep-before-the-foundation-of-the-world (John 10:26-27 + Revelation 13:8 + 17:8). The substantial-three-category-architecture holds: house-of-Yahudah (Judah) + scattered-seed-of-the-house-of-Yashar'el (Israel) + nations. The substantial-Great-Commission walks the substantial-territorial-pursuit-of-the-scattered-seed-of-both-houses substantively-among-the-territories-of-the-nations — the audience is the citizens; the practice is broad proclamation; the nations' place in the covenant-architecture is the substantial-receiving-of-the-priestly-instruction-substance from the gathered-remnant-of-the-twelve-tribes at the substantial-millennial-substance per Micah 4:1-3 + Isaiah 61:6 + Exodus 19:6 + Revelation 1:6 + 5:10 + 20:6.
